infracraft.msg.guide.title: ━━ Subway Building Guide ━━
infracraft.msg.guide.1: 1. Gather: shield machine, tunnel lining (64+), rails, tunnel lights, station blueprint
infracraft.msg.guide.2: 2. Survey: measure distance and height between stations with the surveyor
infracraft.msg.guide.3: 3. Descend: look down (40°+) while using the shield to bore a 1:1 ramp
infracraft.msg.guide.4: 4. Bore: each use cuts a 5×4 slice and lays lining, a rail and a light every 8 blocks
infracraft.msg.guide.5: 5. Power: swap some lining under fast rails for redstone blocks
infracraft.msg.guide.6: 6. Station: stand on the rail facing along the line and use the blueprint
infracraft.msg.guide.7: 7. Elevator: stand on it to rise to the surface; sneak to go down
infracraft.msg.guide.8: 8. Open: name stations with a name tag, then ride once to survey the route
infracraft.msg.guide.9: 9. Run: tickets set destinations, switches route junctions, sneak-use a ticket for express
infracraft.msg.guide.10: 10. Craft a book + rail to get this guide as a book
infracraft.book.subway.1:
━ Subway Handbook ━

Go underground!
Without elytra, a subway
is the fastest and safest
way to travel far.

Follow the steps on
the next pages.
infracraft.book.subway.2:
1. Supplies

· Subway shield machine
· Tunnel lining 64+
  (8 stone + clay → 16)
· Rails (fast/express)
· Tunnel lights
· Station blueprint
· Surveyor, tickets
infracraft.book.subway.3:
2. Planning

Click both station sites
with the surveyor to get
distance and height.
Aim for around Y 0 to
avoid caves and aquifers.
Mark the way with
signposts.
infracraft.book.subway.4:
3. Boring

Use the shield facing
forward: each use cuts a
5×4 slice, lines it,
lays a rail and adds a
light every 8 blocks.
Look down or up for a
1:1 ramp.
infracraft.book.subway.5:
4. Water & lava

Lining is placed before
the slice is cleared, so
aquifers and lava stay
out. Bedrock and block
entities are left alone.
infracraft.book.subway.6:
5. Stations

Stand on the rail facing
along the line and use
the blueprint: two 16-
block platforms, the
station block, lights and
an elevator shaft to the
surface appear at once.
infracraft.book.subway.7:
6. Power & speed

Fast rails need power:
swap some lining under
them for redstone
blocks. Carts slow down
before curves, so keep
lines straight.
infracraft.book.subway.8:
8. More

/infra stations

Have a good trip!
